mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, which reduces the discount rate applied to future equity cash flows and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive in periods where FEDFUNDS declines, as measured by a t-test p-value > 0.05, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 4.0% over two consecutive months signals weakening labor market conditions, which reduces inflationary pressure and increases the likelihood of future monetary easing, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive in triggered instances (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both housing starts and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals a broad-based weakening in aggregate demand, which increases the probability of central bank intervention and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive in joint-triggered instances (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below 108.0 for two consecutive months indicates a contraction in real sector output, which increases the risk of recession and triggers a flight-to-safety dynamic, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative in triggered instances (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC > -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 3.0% combined with a CPI reading above 2.5% signals a tightening monetary cycle amid persistent inflation, which increases real interest rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative in joint-triggered instances (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC > -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) above 520,000 million dollars combined with a rise in housing starts above 1,270,000 units signals strong aggregate demand, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive in joint-triggered instances (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in payroll employment and a rise in the unemployment rate signals labor market deterioration, which increases the likelihood of monetary policy accommodation and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive in joint-triggered instances (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP growth below 1.5% annualized over the past two quarters signals a weakening economy, which increases the probability of fiscal or monetary stimulus and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive in low-GDP-growth periods (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
